reviewer: root independent reading of complete bilingual P profiles
scope: All 13 full bilingual profiles, descriptions and direct prerequisites read in three actual tool outputs. Does not independently verify every source, assessment, image or learner-facing placement. Not a native D round or human approval.

records.reason: Full own calibration, raw data and x/y/vx/vy transfer read in both languages. Residuals alone need not distinguish perspective from physical acceleration; permit an explicitly unresolved cause and specify additional evidence for a causal choice.
Own position data and derived interval averages remain distinct; rest/reversal/sign and rectangle-area transfer fit the narrowed elementary goal. No t-a competence claimed.
Full t-s/t-v/t-a model, initial conditions, signed displacement versus distance, turnaround and invalid post-stop extension are coherently assessed.
Net transported charge, cross-section, reference direction and interval-specific averages remain explicit; pulse versus cycle transfer does not substitute charge for current.
Point-charge force direction, inverse-square scaling and test-charge-independent field are separately observable. This profile review does not resolve every broader prerequisite-placement question.
Given conversion information supports unit meaning; matching nominal values does not claim measurement precision; supplied speed avoids requiring a new motion law.
Fictional source provenance is explicit; E=P t comparisons and pump interface powers use matching conditions. Added stationary/no-stored-energy condition supports the 9 W upper bound.

The goal claims experimental investigation, but supplied readings and planning-led case briefs do not require two own physical executions. Author independently confirmed zero direct assessment coverage. Need own raw measurements, controlled model changes, lens-equation comparisons and a task that cannot pass on supplied example numbers.

Actual own-eye threshold acquisition, fixed prior criterion, repeat scatter and geometric/systematic bounds are preserved. Contrast/illumination transfer is compared with an ideal diffraction estimate, not interpreted as a clinical diagnosis.
Two actual supply-condition series, own I_B/I_C/U_CE values, per-point range checks and distinct ratio/change gain are explicitly required. Supply energy and limited DC claim remain intact.

Signed matched differences with nonzero origins and positive elapsed time are explicit. Recomputed examples: +2 m/s, -3 m/s, overall zero; temperature -1.5 C/min. Endpoints do not establish constant intervening rate.
Two actual calibrated clips and graphical vector subtraction preserve direction change at equal speed. Interval averages are not asserted to be exact instantaneous velocities.
Plan precedes acquisition; window width and center separation are distinct. Second actual trial may validly agree within resolution; no forced acceleration difference or global-fit claim.
